\catcode123=1 \catcode125=2 \catcode35=6 \catcode94=7 \newlinechar=10
\input state-format-source.tex
\message{PYTEXML tables=\tables}
\message{PYTEXML glue=\glues}
\message{PYTEXML units=\units}
\message{PYTEXML after=\after}
\message{PYTEXML case=\lower,\upper}
\message{PYTEXML parameters=\parameters}
\message{PYTEXML font=\fontvalues}
\message{PYTEXML readline=\rawtext}
\message{PYTEXML trueunits=\trueunits}
\immediate\write16{PYTEXML write=\the\count0}
\dump
